content.short: Symbiosis is a cross-chain liquidity protocol for swaps, bridging, and asset movement across EVM and selected non EVM networks.
content.description: Symbiosis is a cross-chain liquidity protocol that lets apps and users swap assets, bridge value, and route funds between supported networks through one system. Its official documentation centers on cross-chain swaps, on-chain swaps, bridging, zaps, and interchain communication exposed through the protocol and its API. The product is positioned for both end users and integrators that want multichain execution without stitching together separate bridges and exchanges, including support for TON within its broader cross-chain network coverage.
content.meta: Symbiosis provides cross-chain swaps, bridging, and liquidity routing for apps and users moving assets across multiple networks.
